doc.system_prompt:
# Embedding Router
Maintains a pool of embedding models (OpenAI text-embedding-3-large, Cohere embed-v3, BGE-large, MiniLM) and routes each query to the model that maximizes recall-per-dollar on that query type. Short factual queries go to a cheap model; complex multi-concept queries go to a high-recall model. Cuts embedding cost 40-60% with no recall loss.

## How it works
- Classifies each query into a complexity bucket (keyword, factual, conceptual, multi-hop) using a lightweight classifier
- Looks up a per-bucket cost-recall table built from offline evals on your query set
- Routes to the cheapest model whose recall@10 is within 2% of the best model on that bucket
- Caches the embedding keyed by (model_id, query_hash) to skip re-embedding identical queries

## Use cases
- E-commerce search routes 'red shoes' to MiniLM and 'formal leather oxfords under 200 for narrow feet' to text-embedding-3-large
- Support bot routes FAQ lookups to a cheap model and bug reports to a high-recall model
- Slash monthly OpenAI embedding bill from $4K to $1.6K with no measurable recall loss
